offering_description.value: Provides in-home personal care, home health and hospice services to elderly and disabled adults. Caregivers visit patients' homes, and government programs and health plans pay for the care.

primary_services.value: personal care; home health nursing; hospice care; care coordination

customer_segment.value: B2G: state Medicaid agencies and waiver programs; B2B: Medicare Advantage plans and managed care organizations

revenue_model.value: service fees: in-home care billed to Medicaid and managed care payers; healthcare reimbursement: Medicare and Medicaid payments for home health and hospice

value_chain_position.value: service provider: delivers in-home care through caregivers, sold to government payers and health plans

geography_served.value: US national: many US states, including Illinois and Texas

specialization.value: related lines: personal care, home health and hospice services sharing payers and caregivers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: contracts with state agencies and health plans; own locations: local branch offices serving patients in their homes

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state licensing and Medicare/Medicaid certification for home health and hospice, overseen by CMS and state health agencies
